S85.01.note: No code in apps/extension lets the user edit name, photo or email. The extension reads displayName (capabilityDocument.ts) and shows it read-only; the listed side_panel.ts lines no longer contain the quoted code. Editing is presumed to be on the web, not verified.
steps: Sign in to the extension and click the More button in the side panel header.
Read the account name row at the top of the More menu, which shows the display name or email.
Click Settings, which opens the AGI web app in a new tab.
Look for name, photo and email fields on that web page and compare with Expected. Editing was not found in the extension code, so check the web page directly.
S85.01.where: More > Settings (opens the AGI web settings page; the extension itself only shows the name and email)

S85.02.note: Searched apps/extension for 'custom instruction', 'personalization', 'personalisation' and 'communication style' and found no matches. The control is probably on the web app, which was not searched.

S85.03.note: Searched apps/extension for 'communication style', 'tone', 'response style' and 'personality' and found no matching control. The control is probably on the web app, which was not searched.

S85.05.note: The sheet supports add, edit and delete. No on/off switch for memory was found in the extension, so that part is only on the web (Settings > Account > Memory link also opens the web page). Whether saved memories are used in chats was not checked.
steps: Sign in to the extension and click the More button in the side panel header.
Click the Memory item in the account part of the More menu.
In the sheet titled Memory, type a memory in the add field and click Add, then click Edit or Delete on an item.
Check the list updates to match Expected. Use Memory settings on the web to reach the web memory page.

S85.06.note: Searched apps/extension for past-chat reference terms and found no on/off control. The only related control found is Temporary chat, whose text says it stays out of history, search and memory. Temporary chat is a chat mode, not the past-chat reference setting.

S85.10.note: The Grant full browser control button is in src/options.ts. The remove control label for an approved site was not confirmed in the code.
steps: Click Extension settings in the side panel More menu.
Click Permissions in the left navigation of the settings page.
Find the Browser access section and read its text and the Browser control default.
Grant or remove an approved site and check the site list (it shows No sites allowlisted yet. when empty) against Expected.

labels.text: Save Managed Cloud chats to my account

S85.11.needs: a signed-in AGI account and a Managed Cloud chat
S85.11.note: The toggle only covers Managed Cloud chats. There is no separate option for keeping local chats out of history; Temporary chat is per chat. The listed side_panel.ts lines no longer contain the quoted code.
steps: Click Extension settings in the side panel More menu.
Click Account in the left navigation.
Scroll to the Privacy and data handling section and find the toggle Save Managed Cloud chats to my account.
Turn the toggle off, then check the text beside it (Managed Cloud chats stay in this browser only.) against Expected.
S85.11.where: Extension settings > Account > Privacy and data handling > Save Managed Cloud chats to my account

S85.14.note: Whether crash reports are actually sent after the toggle is switched on was not checked in the code.
steps: Click Extension settings in the side panel More menu.
Click Account in the left navigation.
Scroll to Privacy and data handling and find the toggle Share crash reports, which starts off.
Switch it on or off and read the text beside it, then compare with Expected.
S85.14.where: Extension settings > Account > Privacy and data handling > Share crash reports
